# FG-CI-0023

| 項目 | 値 |
|---|---|
| HTTP ステータス | 409 |
| 重大度 | info |
| Runbook | なし |
| 発生させるテスト | `one_bad_entry_of_four_is_found_by_bisection` |

## 利用者向けメッセージ

- ja: マージキューで、この MR だけを入れたマージ結果のパイプラインが失敗しました。MR はキューから外されました。パイプラインの診断を確かめて直してから、もう一度キューに入れてください。
- en: In the merge queue, the pipeline on the merge result with only this merge request failed. The merge request was removed from the queue. Read the pipeline diagnosis, fix it and add it to the queue again.
- id: Di antrean merge, pipeline pada hasil merge yang hanya berisi merge request ini gagal. Merge request dikeluarkan dari antrean. Baca diagnosis pipeline, perbaiki, lalu masukkan lagi ke antrean.

## 原因 (cause)

M4 C8 (ADR-0030 §7): the merge queue tested a batch of ONE entry — the merge of this merge request's head on top of the target tip (the train commit `refs/merge-queue/<queue_id>/train`) — and its pipeline (`ci_pipelines.source = merge_queue`, sha = the train) ended red: `failed`, `invalid` (FG-CI-0001), `error` (FG-CI-0002) or `canceled`. A batch of 2–4 that is red is bisected first (the entries go back to the queue and the next batch is the first half), so this code names the culprit once its batch is alone. The entry is `removed` with `reason=checks_failed`; nothing moved the target.

## 調べ方 (diagnosis)

`forge serve` logs `forge.merge_queue.entry_removed` (info) with `error_code`, `request_id` (the batch's), `queue_id`, `batch_id`, `entry_id`, `merge_request_id`, `train_sha`, `pipeline_status` and `pipeline_id`. `gstn queue list --project <id> --target <branch>` shows the removed entry with its reason; the pipeline is `gstn pipeline list --project <id>` (source merge_queue, sha = train_sha) and `gstn pipeline diagnosis --project <id> --pipeline <pipeline_id>`.

## 対処 (fix)

Read the pipeline diagnosis of the train, fix the change (it may only fail together with what is already on the target), push a new version and add the merge request to the queue again (gstn queue add). Nothing to change on the server.
